content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFSU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NFSU Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NFSU Teaching Positions is 21 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500 plus GST. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: For the Research Fellow (Law & Criminology) position, candidates must possess a Master's degree in a relevant or allied discipline with a minimum aggregate of 60%.

faq.question: Q4. Are there any specific requirements for the Assistant Professor (RCI) post?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Assistant Professor (RCI) post, candidates must have a Ph.D. in a relevant or allied discipline with first class in the preceding degree. Additionally, registration as a Clinical Psychologist under the RCI Act is mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Teaching Positions at NFSU?
faq.answer: The salary for the Teaching Positions at NFSU ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 1,94,000 per month, depending on the specific post and experience of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for NFSU Recruitment 2026 typically involves a Screening Test/Skill Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification for NFSU Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NFSU recruitment for permanent or contractual positions?
faq.answer: The NFSU recruitment for these Teaching Positions is on a contractual basis. This provides an opportunity to gain experience and contribute to the university's academic endeavors.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of NFSU?
faq.answer: The National Forensic Sciences University is located in Delhi, with the specific address being Delhi, Pincode: 110085.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: In this recruitment drive, there are a total of 9 vacancies announced for various Teaching Positions at the National Forensic Sciences University.
